summary: Dimdazenil (EVT-201) has been evaluated for insomnia in randomized U.S. clinical trials, including studies at five sleep laboratories.
dosageRemark: No U.S. prescribing dose is provided. Doses used in clinical trials are not treatment instructions.
generalRisks: A U.S. clinical study reported mostly mild or moderate adverse events and a small decline in next-morning digit-symbol test performance. Sedation may affect driving. Alcohol, opioids and other sedatives can increase central nervous system depression.
saferUse: Do not use clinical-trial doses as treatment instructions.
Avoid alcohol and combinations with opioids or other sedatives without medical advice.
Do not drive or operate machinery while impaired.
